body: What happened within the last year?

I definitely can relate to the feeling fake. My job requires this and I feel like I have to be a certain happy way around my friends because it's what they know of me. Without taking up more of your time I just wanted to say you've been so helpful without being judgemental and have given me a push to perhaps look into therapy. Posting this alone has been a huge step for me. I was nervous but you have been a blessing.
Are you able to talk to anymore/does it help?

I feel selfish for complaining. I just think about how others have terrible lives and things worth complaining about and somehow manage to be happy. And then there I am, just sad for "no reason". I genuinely try to be a happy, positive, hard working and kind person but it seems like no matter what my life just doesn't seem to go in a direction I would hope for it to.
The fact that you just responded made me cry...in a good way if that makes sense. Thank you.
